metadata.title: gyeoltare | Next web shell with a Hono boundary
metadata.description: A production-ready setup where Next.js focuses on HTML delivery while Hono owns write paths and shared business logic.

title: A structure where Hono owns the domain boundary and Next focuses on HTML.
description: This scaffold uses the App Router and Server Components while fixing write paths and shared backend rules inside Hono. Read-only view models come directly from the Drizzle read-model layer and can be promoted to Hono endpoints once reuse becomes meaningful.

reads.title: Reads in Server Components
reads.description: Read directly only through the `packages/db/src/read-models/*` layer.

writes.title: Writes and side effects
writes.description: All mutations, transactions and external side effects stay in the Hono service layer.

contract.title: Shared contract
contract.description: Browser and server clients stay aligned through `@gyeoltare/contracts` and `@gyeoltare/api-client`.

featured.title: The home screen is assembled directly from a DB read model.
